outcome.Summary: Rewrote Map in pool/pool.go: results are now written to a preallocated slice by input index (fixing out-of-order results); a `stop` channel closed on the first failure plus a `ctx.Done()` case in the dispatcher make it stop handing out new inputs, and the collector drains all results (tracking the minimum failing index) before returning, so it returns the lowest-index *IndexError, waits for running calls, and never returns (or leaks workers) on cancellation. Added tests covering ordering with skewed fn durations, lowest-index error selection, late-arriving errors, cancellation hang/leak guards, and goroutine-leak detection; `go test -race -count=1 ./...` exits 0.
